turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My exam is open book. So I don't really need to study, right?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's the trap. Open book exams are often harder, because they test whether you can use the information, not just find it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh. That's not what I wanted to hear.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The good news is, you can prepare in a smart way. Organise your notes with tabs, and make a one page index of where everything is.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Like a map of my own notes.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Exactly. And practise answering questions with the book, under time pressure.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: no time to look everything up.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Right. You should know the basics well enough to only check details.
